name: agent-electron
title: Agent Electron
description: Drive cicy-desktop Electron BrowserWindows and per-account sandbox sessions via desktop_event RPC. Each accountIdx = its own session.fromPartition() with proxy. Electron analog of agent-chrome.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Electron
zh-CN.description: 驱动 cicy-desktop 的 Electron BrowserWindow 和 per-account session。accountIdx = sandbox-N partition，可设置 proxy；session 下所有 window 共享代理。对标 agent-chrome 的电子端版本。

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a BrowserWindow under the given session (accountIdx)

tools.name: proxy
tools.description: Set the upstream proxy on a session — applies to every window opened under that accountIdx

tools.name: cdp
tools.description: Send a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol command to a BrowserWindow

tools.name: windows
tools.description: List all live Electron BrowserWindows on the host
